name: es.uji.geotec.backgroundsensors.service.NTPSyncedSensorRecordingService
description: When an app requests sensor recordings with network-time-aligned timestamps, GeoTecINIT BackgroundSensors starts this service and tries to synchronize its clock with an NTP server first; if that fails, it uses the device clock.
disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to record sensor data with network-synchronized timestamps through this service.
